axis: a trait that merely tells one thing from another → a trait that sets a thing above the rest

members.tone: Registers the trait as a sign the thing carries, crediting it lightly where *distinguish* lifts it.
The member that leans hardest on the very positive reading the sense allows — the trait does not merely identify the thing, it raises it above what stands beside it.
The dry one: the trait is what separates this thing from that one, with none of the credit *distinguish* carries.
Flatly descriptive — the trait simply belongs to the thing, and no verdict on its worth comes with it.
